correctness.rationale: For right conjugation the four signed normalized boundary terms in RESULT.md are correct and cancel under d2 by self-distributivity. I independently generated oriented support triples, computed conjugation by relabeling through the inverse of the acting cycle, and removed a directed spanning tree of pair coordinates. On its span d2 is an isomorphism onto the augmentation-zero subgroup, so projection to non-tree pair coordinates identifies ker(d2) with a space of dimension 1521 or 4761 (and preserves d3 rank). Exact elimination over F2 and F3 over all 60840 and 333270 normalized triples gave d3 ranks (1520,1519) and (4761,4759), with the n=5 control giving (360,360). Replay: python3 /workspace/checks/1.py 5 6 7; complete output /workspace/checks/1.txt. The frozen checker and CHECK_OUTPUT were inspected, not executed. The finite connected injective quandle finiteness theorem and torsion-free H1=Z justify interpreting the mod-prime dimensions as counts of p-primary summands, not as torsion exponents.
